pairs.why: The two are nearly identical in their smooth matte finish; A fills the frame with fuller, rounder volume, a bit like the chunky graduation cap and flip-flops.
Both are the same soft-matte render; B's folds are a little deeper and its shading a little stronger near the knot, so it reads slightly more like a real piece of cloth.
Same yellow-tied bandana with the same smooth finish and lighting; I can't see a difference that matters against the real cards.
A's fabric bunches more believably around the knot and the triangle drapes a bit more naturally, while the finish is equally matte in both.
In A the tie ends are the same red polka-dot cloth, held by a slide ring, so it's built like one real bandana; B's knot turns into a separate yellow fabric.
In B the tied ends continue the red dotted fabric, which makes it a coherent object, while A's ends are odd yellow pieces of a different cloth.
A's tie ends are made of the same dotted red cloth as the rest, which reads as a real neckerchief; B's yellow ties look stuck on.
B ties off in the same red polka-dot cloth through a ring, so it's constructed like a real object, unlike A's mismatched yellow ends.
